title: Kernel artifact location
responsibility: Finds an existing kernel build record and available Wasm/native files without building or running them.

inputs.name: kernelArtifacts.env
inputs.description: Environment map, defaulting to process.env; only HARNESS_KERNEL_DIR is read. A non-empty HARNESS_KERNEL_DIR, resolved to an absolute path, is the only directory searched, with no fallback; otherwise ../kernel/, ../../kernel/ and ../../../target/kernel/ relative to the module's import.meta.url are searched in that order.

outputs.name: kernelArtifacts
outputs.description: Holds the first candidate directory that contains build.json, the record parsed from that file (cast to KernelBuild without validation), and the paths of impact-kernel.wasm (core Wasm module) and impact-kernel (native JSON process) inside that directory, each undefined when no entry exists there. All four fields are undefined when no candidate contains build.json, and nothing is built or executed.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by new URL or fileURLToPath (ERR_INVALID_URL or ERR_INVALID_URL_SCHEME) when import.meta.url is missing or is not a file: URL. The beside candidates are built before HARNESS_KERNEL_DIR is checked, so this can throw even when the override is set.

errors.name: Kernel build manifest read failure
errors.description: Thrown by readFileSync when the selected build.json exists but cannot be read, for example when a directory is named build.json (EISDIR), permission is denied (EACCES), or the file is removed after the existence check (ENOENT). The Node error code is on the error's code property.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.parse when the selected build.json is not valid JSON, for example an empty or truncated file. The error is not caught, and no other candidate directory is tried.
